5.3 Sensitive Question Controls
The following question IDs require additional care:

Together:​
039, 057, 061, 062, 063, 072, 080, 081, 083, 085, 087, 088, 089, 091, 092, 095, 096, 099.

Some are simply personal; others warrant explicit opt-in.

Stronger opt-in requirements

Before questions 062, 063, 072, 080, 083, 089, 095 and 096, ensure that players have opted
into the relevant sensitive topic.

Do not introduce these questions as surprise challenges.

If a sensitive question appears in Shuffle mode, the user must have enabled sensitive topics for
that session.

Provide an option to exclude sensitive questions entirely.

Both participants should be comfortable continuing.

A participant can always pass without explanation.
